verdict.rationale: Viam's docs describe the full teleoperation loop. You can stream camera feeds in real time from the browser and drive bases with keyboard controls from the web interface. A base remote control service accepts gamepad or joystick input, and there is a dedicated Teleop interface. For real-world networks, it documents built-in NAT traversal with no VPN or port forwarding, and SDK transports use WebRTC with safety sessions and automatic reconnect. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of video latency and control responsiveness on real networks, and documented video quality or bandwidth adaptation under poor connectivity.
